gbm_population_evidence.quote: Intractable Epilepsy; Malignant Glioma; Seizure Disorder; WHO Grade 2 Glioma; WHO Grade 3 Glioma
Subjects with glioblastoma not following Stupp protocol for treatment of glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase IV trial studies the side effects and how well perampanel works in reducing seizure frequency in patients with high-grade glioma and focal epilepsy.

role_evidence.quote: Perampanel is a drug used to treat seizures.
Patients receive ASD per standard of care for 40 weeks in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

agents.drug_class_hint: generic anti-seizure drugs per standard of care

source_quote.quote: To identify a biomarker-specific response to seizure-reduction in patients treated with PER in patients with a biopsy-proven high-grade glioma

coder_notes: Glioblastoma appears only in an exclusion criterion (GBM patients not on Stupp are excluded, implying Stupp-treated GBM may enter); not named in conditions/title/inclusion, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Perampanel is symptom control with no antitumour hypothesis (supportive).
